preconditions.description: Attacker must be authorized (owner or authorized address) to call setFees function
Attacker must hold some CRACE tokens to trigger fee collection

exploit_hint: As an authorized address, call setFees with extremely high fee percentages (e.g., 5000 for each fee component) and a low feeDenominator (e.g., 100) to set total fee to 100%. Then perform a token transfer to trigger fee collection, causing most of the transferred amount to be taken as fees and distributed to marketing/liquidity receivers (which can be controlled by the attacker). Alternatively, set marketingFeeReceiver to attacker's address and transfer tokens to collect fees.
